title: Unit Event — Find the Dream View — Episode5 The Next Evolution

meta.Event Outline: With their successes performing for a commercial and at Jam Fest, Shiho and the rest of Leo/need are feeling their growth as pro musicians. Then, they get an offer to open for a super popular group's concert.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Free Cluster really draws you right into their world...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You can tell that they put a lot of thought into how they're going to get the audience's attention right from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We usually start by talking to them and stuff, but jumping right in to kick things off seems like a good way to create momentum...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I like how they're using a backlight to make it hard to see them and create a mysterious atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Definitely...!
It must be meant to make everyone wonder what kind of show they're about to witness!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What effects would work the best for us...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see... You'd like to change the lighting plan to grab the crowd's attention?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. For example, when we play star trail, we'd like to have only the spotlights on through the second verse, and turn everything else on right at the start of the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we bring the lights up in the stands too, it'll make everyone feel like they're connected, and build a lot of forward momentum too!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I like it...
Let me know if you have any other ideas like this. I'll bring them up at the show meeting to see what we can make happen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you!
We actually summarized everything in this notebook...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After making those adjustments, we're playing much more in unison now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm thinking so much about how I'm playing that I'm struggling to think about our performance as a whole...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's take a video and see how we're really doing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I wanna see if we can create a better flow, so let's start again from the top.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, here we go!
A few days later
Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Yes, you've improved quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-We have...?!

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Yes, I could tell that you were all working towards a specific goal.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Your playing, crowd interaction and showmanship have all been touched up. Compared to the first time, I felt a much greater sense of excitement.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We couldn't have done this without you, Ms. Naruse. Thank you for being such a great coach.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Haha. I'm honestly not sure how much actual coaching I really did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you helped us make a crucial realization.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After hearing your honest opinion, we were able to take a hard look at ourselves and change our thought process...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We realized just how much effort professional musicians put into their shows.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And how much energy and time they spend to bring their music to the world.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Yes, it takes a lot.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We know that we still need to make a lot of improvements before the show. So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We look forward to your continued support.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Hehe. I like that hungry look in your eye.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Of course, I'll keep giving you all as much help as I can. The better you do, the easier it'll be for us, after all.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: But you're right. You still have a lot of work left ahead of you. So, start again from the top for me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Why don't we take a break here?
You all look a bit worn out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Good job sticking it out, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Oh, that's my agency...
Sorry, I need to take this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
My brain and body are both totally wiped out...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're gonna be playing at a big arena, so we'll need to exaggerate a lot in order to make sure everyone can see what we're doing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, thanks to Ms. Naruse, our playing and performances have definitely improved.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. And we've got plenty of concrete points to improve on, so let's keep on polishing until the show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Everyone's gonna be totally blown away by the new and improved Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Are we gonna be announced as the opening act soon?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I totally forgot. They're making the announcement on social media today, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... Free Cluster's official account... Found it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Check it out!
It says, “Opening Act: Leo/need,” right here...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, look at that...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We really get to open for Free Cluster...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this is pretty cool.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, look here!
Some people have already posted comments! This person said, “Woohoo!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we gotta make sure they have a ton of fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... Look at this comment...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Lemme see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: “They've gotta get a better band. This gives Free Cluster a bad name.”
